position: Founder / Ecom, Fintech & SaaS Automation Strategist
about:
With a strong foundation in communication from my studies at Universidad ORT Uruguay and legal training from Universidad Católica del Uruguay, I have dedicated my career to driving growth and innovation across eCommerce, fintech, and SaaS industries. Over the years, I’ve honed my expertise in digital marketing, sales strategies, and lifecycle systems while holding leadership roles that focused on developing tailored solutions to maximize revenue for businesses. My multilingual skills in English, Spanish, and Portuguese further enable me to connect with a diverse range of clients globally.

As the founder of Kunko Agency by Domus Global, I lead a retention-first lifecycle marketing agency specializing in Email Marketing, SMS strategies, WhatsApp campaigns, CRM automation, and AI-powered tools. Our mission is clear: to help e-commerce and SaaS brands achieve profitable scaling by boosting customer lifetime value (CLTV) while easing customer acquisition cost (CAC) pressure. With over $120M in tracked revenue across 15+ years of experience as a team combined with innovative full-funnel strategies blending creativity with data analysis—our clients benefit from predictable growth through optimized customer journeys. Contact me today if you're ready to unlock sustainable success with cutting-edge retention marketing!
